levy_age_rolls.name: Levy Age Rolls
levy_age_rolls.observation: Scribes list every man by age, so the levy and the labour draft fall on those fit to serve.

eldest_double_share.name: Eldest's Double Share
eldest_double_share.observation: The eldest son takes a double share of the family land, so the holding is not cut into strips too small to feed a house.
eldest_double_share.social_consequence: Younger sons marry late or leave for the towns, the army and the colonies.

overseas_colony_founding.name: Overseas Colonies
overseas_colony_founding.observation: When the land is full, a crowded town chooses its young men and sends them over the sea to found a new town.
overseas_colony_founding.ability_reason: Sending a crowded town's surplus young people over the sea founds new towns and eases hunger at home.
overseas_colony_founding.social_consequence: Those who stay have land enough; those who go leave for good.

intertown_marriage_rights.name: Intertown Marriage Rights
intertown_marriage_rights.observation: Treaties let citizens of allied towns marry, and their children count as lawful heirs in both.

resident_alien_status.name: Resident Aliens
resident_alien_status.observation: Foreigners who settle are registered, pay a head tax and live under a citizen patron, but may not own land.

foundling_rescue.name: Foundling Rescue
foundling_rescue.observation: Babies left exposed at the crossroads are taken up and raised by others, some as children and some as servants.

heir_adoption.name: Adopted Heirs
heir_adoption.observation: A childless man adopts a grown heir to carry on his house, his rites and his land.

heiress_marriage_rule.name: Heiress Marriage Rule
heiress_marriage_rule.observation: A daughter with no brothers must marry her nearest kinsman so the land stays in the family, however young she is.

dowry_as_inheritance.name: Dowry as Inheritance
dowry_as_inheritance.observation: A daughter's dowry counts as her share of the family property and goes back with her if the marriage ends.

age_class_enrollment.name: Age-class Enrollment
age_class_enrollment.observation: Youths are enrolled with their age-mates and trained together, and each class keeps its bonds for life.

forced_resettlement.name: Forced Resettlement
forced_resettlement.observation: Whole conquered peoples are marched off to new land by order, and strangers are settled in their place.
forced_resettlement.ability_reason: Moving a conquered people breaks their power to rebel and puts their hands to work where the ruler wants them.
forced_resettlement.social_consequence: The uprooted remember; the ruler gains labour and loses love.

planned_colony_lots.name: Equal Colony Lots
planned_colony_lots.observation: New settlements are surveyed into equal family lots, so every founding family starts with the same share.

single_wife_households.name: One Lawful Wife
single_wife_households.observation: Custom allows a man one lawful wife, and only her children are his heirs.

kin_birth_registration.name: Kin Birth Registration
kin_birth_registration.observation: At the kin festival each new child is presented and entered on the list of the brotherhood.

double_descent_citizenship.name: Two-parent Citizenship
double_descent_citizenship.observation: Only a child of two citizen parents is a citizen; the children of foreign mothers are not.
double_descent_citizenship.ability_reason: Limiting membership to children of two member parents binds the citizen body tight, and shuts out the incomer's children.
double_descent_citizenship.social_consequence: Citizens close ranks; mixed families are pushed to the edge.

unfree_headcount.name: Bond-servant Count
unfree_headcount.observation: The census counts bond-servants apart from free households, as property of their masters.

military_settler_colonies.name: Soldier-settler Colonies
military_settler_colonies.observation: Soldiers are settled on confiscated land in the conquered province, to farm it and hold it for the ruler.

epitaph_age_records.name: Ages on Grave Stones
epitaph_age_records.observation: Grave stones record the age of the dead in years, months and days.

household_tax_registers.name: Household Tax Registers
household_tax_registers.observation: Officials list each household head with his family's land and livestock, for tax and service.
household_tax_registers.ability_reason: A register of every household lets the state tax and call up the whole land, not only the villages near the palace.

twin_birth_customs.name: Twin Birth Customs
twin_birth_customs.observation: Twins are no longer taken as an ill omen; midwives expect the second child and work to keep both.

mourning_limits.name: Mourning Limits
mourning_limits.observation: Law limits the length of mourning and the cost of funerals, so families are not ruined by grief.

widow_remarriage_custom.name: Widow Remarriage
widow_remarriage_custom.observation: A widow may remarry after a set term of mourning, keeping her portion for her children.

refugee_land_settlement.name: Refugee Land Grants
refugee_land_settlement.observation: Refugees are granted empty land in return for military service and taxes.

town_consolidation.name: Town Consolidation
town_consolidation.observation: Neighbouring villages agree to become one town, with a single council, market and wall.
town_consolidation.ability_reason: Merging villages into one town gathers people, crafts and defence in one place, along with the sicknesses that feed on crowding.
town_consolidation.social_consequence: The town grows strong, and the fevers of crowded streets grow with it.

majority_enrollment.name: Coming of Age by Roll
majority_enrollment.observation: At a fixed age each youth is entered on the roll of adult citizens and takes up their rights and duties.

family_size_counsel.name: Counsel on Family Size
family_size_counsel.observation: Elders and lawgivers counsel households to raise no more children than their land can feed.

property_class_census.name: Property-class Census
property_class_census.observation: Every citizen declares his age and property and is enrolled in a class that sets his tax, his vote and his service.
property_class_census.ability_reason: Counting citizens by age and property sorts them into classes that decide who pays, who votes and who fights in what armour.

contraceptive_herbs.name: Contraceptive Herbs
contraceptive_herbs.observation: Women trade herbs and resins said to prevent or end a pregnancy, and some who take them sicken.

craftsman_naturalization.name: Naturalized Craftsmen
craftsman_naturalization.observation: Skilled incomers are granted local rights so they settle, bring their families and teach their craft.

written_wills.name: Written Wills
written_wills.observation: A man writes out his will before witnesses and seals it, choosing his heirs and legacies.
written_wills.ability_reason: A written will lets a man choose his heirs and provide for widow and daughters instead of leaving everything to custom.

orphan_guardianship.name: Orphan Guardians
orphan_guardianship.observation: Magistrates name guardians for orphans, who manage their property and must account for it when they come of age.

harvest_labor_migration.name: Harvest Migration
harvest_labor_migration.observation: Bands of hill folk walk down to the plains each summer to reap for wages, and carry fevers home with their pay.

freed_person_status.name: Freed Persons
freed_person_status.observation: A freed bond-servant gets a fixed status, free but still bound to serve the former master's house.

colony_kin_ties.name: Colony Kin Ties
colony_kin_ties.observation: Colonies send envoys and offerings to the mother town's festivals, and light their own hearths from its fire.

offering_birth_counts.name: Shrine Birth Counts
offering_birth_counts.observation: Temple keepers count births by the coins and cakes offered at the shrine.

trained_midwives.ability_reason: Midwives trained under masters and recognised by the town bring skill to more births than kinswomen alone ever could.

war_orphan_upkeep.name: War Orphans' Upkeep
war_orphan_upkeep.observation: Sons of men killed in war are raised at public cost and given armour when they come of age.

veteran_land_allotments.name: Veterans' Allotments
veteran_land_allotments.observation: Old soldiers are given land on discharge, and whole districts fill with veterans' farms.

birth_declaration_deadline.name: Birth Declarations
birth_declaration_deadline.observation: Parents must declare each birth to a magistrate within a set number of days.

mixed_foundation_towns.name: Mixed Foundations
mixed_foundation_towns.observation: New towns are founded with settlers of many peoples, each quarter with its own tongue and gods.

fetal_position_knowledge.name: Fetal Positions
fetal_position_knowledge.observation: Healers and midwives describe how the child lies in the womb and which presentations will not deliver.

midwifery_manuals.name: Midwifery Manuals
midwifery_manuals.observation: Written manuals teach midwives how to prepare, deliver, cut the cord and care for mother and child.
midwifery_manuals.ability_reason: Written manuals of birth let a midwife in any town learn what the best of them know.

birthing_chair.name: Birthing Chair
birthing_chair.observation: A chair with hand grips and a cut-out seat helps the mother push while the midwife receives the child.

periodic_citizen_census.name: Five-yearly Census
periodic_citizen_census.observation: Every five years each citizen declares under oath his household, bond-servants and property.
periodic_citizen_census.ability_reason: A sworn census every five years gives rulers a true count of citizens, property and fighting strength.

hired_child_minders.name: Hired Child-minders
hired_child_minders.observation: Households hire nursemaids and child-minders, freeing mothers to work or keep house.

adult_succession_adoption.name: Adoption for Succession
adult_succession_adoption.observation: Great men adopt grown heirs to inherit house and office, and power passes to the chosen rather than the born.

triennial_household_registers.name: Three-yearly Registers
triennial_household_registers.observation: Household registers are renewed every three years, keeping the tax rolls close to the truth.

city_grain_migration.name: Drift to the Grain City
city_grain_migration.observation: The countryside poor leave their fields for the city, drawn by public grain and crowded into its tenements.
city_grain_migration.social_consequence: The city swells and its fields thin; crowd fevers and bread riots come with the grain.

feeding_horns.name: Feeding Horns
feeding_horns.observation: Babies whose mothers have no milk are fed goat's milk from horns and spouted cups; many thrive, and many sicken of the soured spouts.

tenement_crowding.name: Tenement Blocks
tenement_crowding.observation: Rented blocks of five and six floors crowd the large towns; they fall and burn, and fevers pass from floor to floor.
tenement_crowding.social_consequence: The poor have roofs, but neither air nor light.

garrison_farm_colonies.name: Garrison Farms
garrison_farm_colonies.observation: Garrisons farm their own land, and soldiers' families grow up around the forts.

postmortem_cesarean.name: Child Cut from the Dead
postmortem_cesarean.observation: When a mother dies in labour the child is cut from her body, and sometimes it lives.

nursing_mother_diet.name: Nursing Mothers' Diet
nursing_mother_diet.observation: Healers set rules for what a nursing mother should eat and drink, and when she should wean.

service_membership.name: Membership for Service
service_membership.observation: Foreign soldiers who complete their service are made members, and their sons with them.

fertile_day_counting.name: Counting Fertile Days
fertile_day_counting.observation: Some reckon the fertile days of the month to time or avoid conception, not always rightly.

marriage_incentive_laws.name: Marriage Incentive Laws
marriage_incentive_laws.observation: The law grants privileges to parents of three children and taxes the unmarried and the childless.
marriage_incentive_laws.ability_reason: Rewarding parents of three and fining the unwed pushes the propertied to marry and raise heirs, though no law makes them want children.
marriage_incentive_laws.social_consequence: The rich grumble and find loopholes; the census counts more marriages.

registered_marriage.name: Registered Marriage
registered_marriage.observation: Marriages are recorded with a magistrate, and a registered wife's children are lawful heirs.

alimentary_child_funds.name: Child Grain Funds
alimentary_child_funds.observation: Estates are pledged to an endowment, and its interest buys monthly grain for the district's poor children.
alimentary_child_funds.ability_reason: Endowed funds paying monthly grain for poor children keep them fed through the years when hunger kills the young.

deserted_land_grants.name: Deserted Land Grants
deserted_land_grants.observation: Farmland left empty by war or flight is granted to any settler who will till it and pay the tax.

daily_death_counts.name: Daily Death Counts
daily_death_counts.observation: In pestilence years officials count the dead at each gate every day and report the numbers to the council.

childless_estate_escheat.name: Heirless Estates to the Treasury
childless_estate_escheat.observation: Estates with no heir by blood or will pass to the public treasury.

wet_nurse_licensing.name: Licensed Wet Nurses
wet_nurse_licensing.observation: Wet nurses are registered and inspected, and one with thin milk or a sick child is turned away.

post_plague_resettlement.name: Resettling Emptied Towns
post_plague_resettlement.observation: When pestilence empties a town, settlers are invited to take the vacant houses and fields.

congregation_widow_rolls.name: Widows' Rolls
congregation_widow_rolls.observation: Congregations keep rolls of widows and orphans and feed them from the common chest.

internal_passes.name: Internal Passes
internal_passes.observation: No one may leave their registered village without a sealed pass from the magistrate.
internal_passes.social_consequence: The count stays true because people cannot move; the restless grumble and the enterprising stay put.

annuity_life_tables.name: Tables of Years Remaining
annuity_life_tables.observation: Jurists draw up tables of the years a person of each age may expect to live, to value legacies and pensions.

head_land_tax_units.name: Head-and-Land Tax Units
head_land_tax_units.observation: Assessors count heads and land together into tax units, and each village owes by its units.
head_land_tax_units.ability_reason: Tax units joining heads and land let the state assess a whole empire on one scale, and tie the taxed to the land where they were counted.
head_land_tax_units.social_consequence: Farmers are bound to the land where they were counted.

celibate_communities.name: Celibate Communities
celibate_communities.observation: Men and women withdraw into communities that renounce marriage for a life of prayer and work.

federate_settlement.name: Federate Settlement
federate_settlement.observation: A whole migrating people is granted frontier land in exchange for fighting under their own chiefs.
federate_settlement.ability_reason: Settling a whole migrating people as allies gives the state soldiers and farmers at once, and a people inside its borders who answer to their own kings.
